messages:
Liam O'Connor: FYI - Medivance Health (enterprise payer) just escalated. CTO says go/no-go for the POC hinges on BYO KMS and a scoped SOC2 excerpt. They're asking for an exec call Wed 11am ET.
Nina Gomez: On it. Do we have a pre-approved SOC2 redaction bundle we can share under NDA?
Jordan Bell: Legal: yes, we have a redacted SOC2 package and an NDA template. I'll prep the redaction checklist.
Evan Park: Technical note: our BYO-KMS flow works with Private deployments today. For Dedicated we can do a limited key wrapping shim but it requires an addendum. It adds ~2 days to provisioning if contracts sign quickly.
Priya Rao: Medivance also asked for committed pricing for the POC (they want a 90-day trial with SLA). Price MR asked for 30% off if we host Dedicated. Thoughts?
Nina Gomez: 30% seems aggressive. Suggest counter: 15% off + $X in usage credits + standard POC SLA. We should tie deeper discounts to a multi-quarter commit.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed. We need an SVP on the call to signal seriousness. Can someone check VP availability?
Jordan Bell: I'll check and ask for sign-off language in the pre-call email.
Evan Park: Quick config snippet to show the BYO binding for Private (for demo):
```
redwood:
  kms:
    mode: customer_managed
    provider: aws-kms
    key_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
  network:
    peering_cidr: 10.20.0.0/16
```
Nina Gomez: Ops question - how long to stand up a Private node in their VPC if they grant role access?
Evan Park: ~48-72 hours once we have IAM role + CIDR + peer acceptance.
Priya Rao: Action items for demo: 1) Legal: NDA + SOC2 redaction bundle (Jordan). 2) Eng: BYO config slide + risk mitigation (Evan). 3) Sales: pricing counter + exec invite (Nina/Liam). 4) Ops: provisioning ETA confirmation (OpsBot).
Jordan Bell: Drafting NDA email now. Will attach SOC2 excerpt instructions and ask for vendor KMS attestation.
LegalBot: [auto] NDA template attached: redwood-non-disclosure-template-v2.pdf. Use internal review channel for edits.
Nina Gomez: For pricing counter: propose 15% off + 60% credits up to $X for POC, plus option to convert to Dedicated reserved capacity at a discounted share rate.
Liam O'Connor: I'll reach out to VP to join Wed call; will confirm by EOD.
Evan Park: Also flag: If customer demands BYO-KMS in Dedicated without addendum, we should not promise live keys in our infra until legal signs off.
Priya Rao: Pre-call ask to customer (to include in invite): 1) Confirm KMS vendor + contact, 2) Provide KMS attestation or SOC evidence, 3) CIDR for peering, 4) Infra IAM role ARN, 5) Any procurement timeline constraints.
OpsBot: [reminder] Created calendar invite "Medivance POC exec signoff" Wed 11:00 ET 1: attendees: Liam O'Connor, Nina Gomez, Evan Park, Jordan Bell, Priya Rao.
Jordan Bell: I'll circulate the draft NDA + SOC2 redaction guidance by tomorrow 09:00 ET. Please review.
Nina Gomez: If legal needs a special addendum for PHI holdback, is there a template?
Jordan Bell: I'll reuse the PHI addendum template and tailor to their asks. ETA: tomorrow lunchtime.
Liam O'Connor: OK team - let's aim to have materials in the invite 24hrs before the call. We should present two clear paths on the call: Private (fast, supports BYO-KMS) vs Dedicated (faster infra but requires contract addendum for BYO).
Evan Park: I'll prepare a slide with estimated timelines, token cost delta, and a simple security mitigation list for BYO keys.
Priya Rao: Perfect. I'll send the pre-call note to Medivance in 45m and attach the checklist.
Jordan Bell: Note to team - if Medivance insists on Dedicated + BYO now, pause the demo and flag for legal escalation immediately.
Nina Gomez: Understood. I'll draft the pricing counter and share in this thread by 16:00 PT.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in this thread after materials are uploaded. :thumbsup:
